description: This source file defines the OutputFormatter struct and associated methods for consistent output formatting, including various message types (success, error, info, warning, header, verbose, progress) with colorized icons and text.

classes.name: OutputFormatter
classes.description: Provides a set of methods for formatted, colored terminal output, including success, error, info, warning, header, verbose, and progress messages, with control over verbose mode.

methods.name: NewOutputFormatter
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new OutputFormatter instance with specified verbose mode.

methods.name: PrintSuccess
methods.description: Prints a success message with a green checkmark.

methods.name: PrintError
methods.description: Prints an error message with a red X.

methods.name: PrintInfo
methods.description: Prints an informational message with a blue info icon.

methods.name: PrintWarning
methods.description: Prints a warning message with a yellow warning icon.

methods.name: PrintHeader
methods.description: Prints a header message with an agentfield emoji and bold text.

methods.name: PrintVerbose
methods.description: Prints a verbose message only if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: PrintProgress
methods.description: Prints a progress message with a spinner-like icon.

methods.name: IsVerbose
methods.description: Returns whether verbose mode is enabled.
